title: DockPrepBench: How much does preparation matter in molecular docking?
description: A paired benchmark of how search-space and ligand preparation choices change docking success on the PoseBusters set, across four engines, with an interactive results explorer (https://david-alobo.github.io/DockPrepBench/). Code accompanying the paper 'How much does preparation matter in molecular docking? A paired benchmark of search-space and ligand preparation choices across four engines'.
